installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update && apt install -y curl jq unzip
R=$(curl -sSL https://api.github.com/repos/SubnauticaNitrox/Nitrox/releases/latest)
U=$(echo "$R" | jq -r '.assets[].browser_download_url' | grep -i linux_x64 | head -1)
cd /mnt/server
curl -sSL -o nitrox.zip "$U"
unzip -o nitrox.zip -d nitrox
rm nitrox.zip
chmod +x nitrox/* 2>/dev/null || true
